extension_disclosure: Excluded from round1 and round2 selection, but other repository studies may have seen August. One month is not sufficient evidence of robustness.
known_data_disclosure: All history through July 2026 was viewed in round1; round2 rolling OOS is procedural, not historically blind.
score: 0.15*legacy utility + 0.85*mean recent fold utility - 0.30*recent Sharpe std; utility=Sharpe+0.5*annual log growth-2*absolute max drawdown; no candidate with recent drawdown >35% or legacy drawdown >55%
walkforward: At each half-year boundary choose using only prior return observations, with a 14-day evaluation embargo; use next fold equity for procedural OOS audit.
stage2: Top 2 development core profiles and top 2 tactical profiles, if tactical annual growth positive, routed at allocations 0.25/0.5/1.0. Up to 12 fixed combinations. No parameter changes based on extension.
cost: Hourly proxy: taker4bps+slippage2bps; final 1m: taker4bps+base1bps+impact8bps*sqrt(participation), no rebate, real funding, adverse gaps, margin checks
selection: Freeze final choice after development-only minute verification of at most six finalists; reserve extension unopened until freeze.
leverage: No leverage optimization; core cap4x, tactical pullback cap1.5x and breakout cap3x, short cap0.5x. Controls against original versions must use identical execution cost.
